description: Shared display-name helpers for diagram stencils: resolves a stencil's localized display name (resource key with a fallback to the raw name) and lists the stencils that are connectable shapes (nodes only — edge stencils style relationships and must not appear in shape-picking surfaces such as the connect modal).

members.name: GetStencilDisplayName
members.description: Returns the localized display name for a stencil: the translation of its NameResourceKey when the key resolves, otherwise the stencil's raw name.

members.name: GetLocalizedText
members.description: Resolves a localized text for a resource key, falling back to the provided value when the key is empty or untranslated (localizers echoing [key] are treated as missing).

members.name: GetConnectableStencils
members.description: Returns the connectable stencils from the registry — node stencils only, in the registry's display order.
